notes.title: v1.1.0 - Small Changes
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!
I am happy to announce an update of the BOX align, if you have any problems please let me know in the community HUB :)

> Added new settings
> Added brightness control (some monitors were too light)
> Improved HUD visibility
> Added a new image in level 1 to rate the camera 
[b](Remember: click and hold the left mouse button on the ground to rotate the camera)[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31928055/4b7c883ac5c15b5d1c9aaa686e368247ddd2e03b.jpg[/img]

Hope you like it!
Cheers
